Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : shivangi ki shadi men umra logon ka sailab | Shivangi Singh | Barat
Bihar ke mokama se vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ka aayojan charcha men hai. is mauke par aayojit ghurdaur dekhne ke lie bari sankhya men log nadva ganv pahunche. bhir itni barh gaee ki sarak par karib 10 kilomitar se jyada lanba jam lag gaya.
